body = _input.first().json.get('body', {})

# Forensic regex pattern matching

    chips = ['Dekripsi data PROJECT_EVE', 'Tanyakan PROJECT_EVE ke Android K-9', 'Cari sumber EMP di penthouse']

    chips = ['Lacak jejak subnet internal', 'Uji apakah AI berbohong', 'Minta log akses 24 jam']

    chips = ['Kirim sampel ke lab forensik', 'Kejar jejak ke balkon luar', 'Interogasi security gedung']

return [{'json': {'content': reply, 'chips': chips}}]
